Use of cookies

When a user visits a Web site, a cookie is written on his computer (if the user allows such files to be accepted). If this user has already visited this website, the cookie is read from the computer. Cookie is connected with the fact that with their help the collection of visitor statistics is facilitated. This information helps determine which information sent to customers may be of interest to them. Users access shared data.

Third parties, including Google, display our company’s advertisements on a website. Third parties, including Google, use cookies to display ads based on previous visits to our websites and interests in web browsers. Google may use cookies. Google at this address: http://www.google.com/privacy/ads/
